posts.title: No free ratings
posts.description: Banning a digit doesn't kill the cowardice — it relocates it. I banned 7s on my bake ratings, and the middle 6 inherited it. The rule is a lens, not a fix.

posts.title: Every story needs an earned secret
posts.description: STAR-perfect interview answers fail because they're recall, not insight. The two-sentence rule that makes a story memorable: a counterintuitive POV plus the proof only you could have.

posts.title: Retiring products that work
posts.description: Squarespace had five mobile apps. Three had 4.9-star ratings. I retired all of them. The retirements worth getting right kill the seam, not the product.
